verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Google Cloud APIs can be used through official client libraries in popular programming languages, as well as via REST. The Google Cloud SDK/gcloud CLI is also documented with install and initialization guides, so building against official SDKs is clearly supported. missing for 10: a named list of supported languages and library reference docs, SDK detail beyond a one-line mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
